name: R.U.A.
source:
In the not so distant future, you are awoken to repair one of mankind's last ditch efforts for survival: The Isra II Transport Ship. Things go awry quickly. Leaving you stranded on a rogue asteroid to fend for yourself with only one companion - and key to you surviving: R.U.A. - one of the ship's Robotic Utility Assistants.

How long will you survive? Will you make it out? Can your companion keep you from getting cabin fever?

[From [url=https://pillowprincessgames.itch.io/rua]itch.io[/url]]
